Kwame, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from 11/2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's recap note from Dec 8, 2025 gives the same official date.

Bettina's note also says she kept running the account day to day until the terminal cutover finished. You took over operationally on **November 22, 2025**. For the CRM, I'd use 11/3 as the official ownership date. You could log 11/22 as the day-to-day start if there's a field for it.
